title: Discover China | Beijing-Shanghai Symphony
highlights: Experience the Best of Beijing & Shanghai, featuring iconic attractions, cultural experiences, and thrilling entertainment.
Walk along Juyongguan, one of the most well-preserved sections of the Great Wall, and admire its strategic significance, scenic landscapes, and centuries-old watchtowers.
Explore the Forbidden City, the world’s largest palace complex, where imperial history comes alive through intricate architecture, fascinating relics, and tales of China’s dynastic rulers.
Experience the magic of Shanghai Disneyland with its thrilling rides, mesmerizing shows, and unique attractions that blend Disney's enchantment with Chinese cultural influences.
Sail along the Huangpu River on a scenic cruise, marvelling at Shanghai’s illuminated skyline as attractions like The Bund and Oriental Pearl Tower create a stunning nighttime panorama.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Beijing | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to China! Upon arrival at Beijing Capital International Airport, you’ll get transferred to your hotel. Check-in and spend the day at leisure, exploring the city, trying local delicacies, or visiting Wangfujing Street, famous for its shopping and street food. Beijing, China's capital for over 800 years, boasts a mix of imperial history and modern marvels. You can also visit the Beijing Ancient Observatory, explore Madame Tussauds, or enjoy the New World Plaza’s 10th-floor attractions.

days.title: Full-Day Mutianyu Great Wall & Summer Palace Tour
days.desc: Today, get ready to explore Juyongguan, one of the most strategic and well-preserved sections of the Great Wall, built to defend Beijing. Walk along its winding paths and admire stunning mountain views. Later, you will be taken to the Summer Palace, a UNESCO World Heritage site, known for its vast gardens, Longevity Hill, and Kunming Lake, once an imperial retreat for the Qing dynasty. Afterwards, you will transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Full-Day Great Wall & Summer Palace Tour, Beijing on a Shared basis

days.title: Tiananmen Square and Forbidden City Half Day Trip
days.desc: On this day, begin your day with a visit to Tiananmen Square, one of the world’s largest public squares, home to the Monument to the People’s Heroes and Mao Zedong’s Mausoleum. Further, explore the Forbidden City, the world’s largest palace complex with 980 buildings, once home to 24 emperors. Admire its intricate halls, vast courtyards, and ancient relics. Conclude your day by getting transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Tiananmen Square and Forbidden City Half Day Trip on a Shared basis

days.title: Transfer to Shanghai | Huangpu River Cruise
days.desc: On this day, check-out of the hotel and get transferred to Beijing Airport for your flight to Shanghai. Upon reaching, you’ll be taken to the hotel for check-in. In the evening, enjoy a Huangpu River Cruise, offering stunning views of Shanghai’s skyline, including The Bund and the futuristic Oriental Pearl Tower. The illuminated cityscape reflects on the water, showcasing Shanghai’s transformation from a historic trading port to a global metropolis.

days.title: Day Trip to Disneyland
days.desc: Spend the day at Shanghai Disneyland, China’s first Disney park, featuring unique attractions like TRON Lightcycle Power Run and Pirates of the Caribbean: Battle for the Sunken Treasure. Experience magical parades, and themed lands, and meet beloved Disney characters, making for an unforgettable day of adventure and fun. Later, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Shanghai City Tour | Shanghai Zoo with Panda Hall
days.desc: Today, explore Shanghai’s cultural gems on a city tour, starting at Jade Buddha Temple, famous for its rare white jade Buddha statues. Further, stroll through Yu Garden, a Ming Dynasty masterpiece with beautiful pavilions, and ponds. Visit Longhua Temple and Pagoda, Shanghai’s oldest Buddhist site, known for its sacred rituals. Stop at People’s Square, a cultural hub with historic landmarks. Later, visit Shanghai Zoo’s Panda Hall, home to giant pandas in a naturalistic habitat.

items.title: Half-Day Shanghai Sightseeing Tour on a Shared basis
Shanghai Zoo Tickets on a Shared basis

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check-out of the hotel and get transferred to the airport for your onward flight. Take with you unforgettable memories of China’s rich history, iconic landmarks, and vibrant culture.
